title: Counter service
caption: The owner said they were out of the swamp special.
blurb: A small alligator entered a bagel shop in Southport, North Carolina, through the back door and stood at the front counter. The owner called 911, and no one was hurt.
alt_text: An alligator at a bagel shop counter, with the owner holding a chair.

title: Cow convention
caption: The real cow had been saying for years that nobody would notice.
blurb: A basketball team in Frederick, Maryland, set a world record when 1,902 fans dressed as cows at their annual event. The previous record was set in Australia in 2014.
alt_text: A crowd in cow costumes, with a real cow in the front row wearing the same costume.

title: The raccoon memorial
caption: A quarter mile of traffic waited to view the memorial.
blurb: Two brothers on Bainbridge Island built a fourteen-foot animatronic raccoon as a Halloween decoration. The giant creature drew long lines of visiting cars and required internal maintenance through a rear access hatch.
alt_text: Two small raccoons gaze up at a giant mechanical raccoon with glowing eyes in a front yard.

title: Patient audience
caption: The pigs appreciated the thirty-two hours of preparation.
blurb: A record-breaking pumpkin weighing over three thousand pounds was carved into the heaviest jack-o-lantern ever in Salem, Massachusetts. After Halloween the decorated gourd was donated as feed for pigs.
alt_text: Two pigs watch from behind a fence as someone carves a gigantic jack-o-lantern.
